epic.name: React Web Portal Integration & Enhancement
epic.description: Integrate production-ready React + TypeScript web portal with 4 core capabilities: Human-in-the-Loop Interventions, Real-Time Visualizations, Transparency Insights, and Message Streaming. Total codebase: 6,550 lines across 9 major components.
successCriteria: All 9 React components integrated and functional
Human interventions successfully routed to agents

phases.name: Phase 0: Current State Assessment & Planning
phases.description: Evaluate current vanilla portal vs React portal, identify integration points, and create migration strategy

tasks.title: Assess Current Vanilla Portal Capabilities
tasks.description: Document all features in current simple-portal-server.cjs implementation (10 tabs: Overview, Swarms, Repos, Performance, Agents, Hierarchy, Fleet, CFN Loop, Events, Logs)

tasks.title: Conduct Feature Gap Analysis
tasks.description: Compare vanilla portal (10 tabs, ~1300 lines) vs React portal (9 components, 6550 lines). Identify overlap, gaps, and unique features in each.

tasks.title: Design Integration Strategy
tasks.description: Decide: (A) Replace vanilla portal with React, (B) Hybrid approach with both, (C) Gradual migration tab-by-tab. Consider: Bundle size (300KB vs 5MB), maintenance complexity, feature richness.

tasks.title: Audit Backend API Readiness
tasks.description: Verify which of 14 required REST endpoints are implemented. Check WebSocket protocol support for 5 event types (agent-update, message, decision-point, metrics-update, intervention-ack).

tasks.title: Create Detailed Migration Plan
tasks.description: Document step-by-step migration approach with rollback strategy. Include: data migration, deployment sequence, testing strategy, monitoring plan.

successCriteria: Migration plan with rollback strategy created

phases.name: Phase 1: Backend API & WebSocket Foundation
phases.description: Implement required backend APIs and WebSocket infrastructure to support React portal

tasks.title: Implement Missing REST API Endpoints
tasks.description: Create 14 required endpoints: GET /api/agents, GET /api/agents/:id, GET /api/agents/hierarchy, GET /api/messages, GET /api/messages?agent=:id, GET /api/messages?thread=:id, GET /api/metrics, GET /api/metrics/history, GET /api/decisions, GET /api/decisions/:id, POST /api/decisions, POST /api/decisions/:id/feedback, PUT /api/decisions/:id/outcome, POST /api/interventions, GET /api/interventions/history, GET /api/tests, GET /api/tests/metrics

tasks.title: Implement WebSocket Protocol
tasks.description: Create WebSocket server supporting: Client→Server (subscribe, intervention, feedback) and Server→Client (agent-update, message, decision-point, metrics-update, intervention-ack) event types.

tasks.title: Extend Redis Pub/Sub for Portal Events
tasks.description: Subscribe to additional Redis channels for decision tracking, intervention routing, and metrics updates. Publish to swarm:*:interventions, swarm:*:decisions channels.
acceptanceCriteria: Portal subscribed to swarm:*:events, swarm:*:logs, swarm:*:decisions
Interventions routed via Redis to agents

tasks.title: Implement Security Layer
tasks.description: Add input validation, rate limiting (10 interventions/min), CSRF protection, WebSocket origin validation, Content Security Policy headers.

tasks.title: Create API Documentation
tasks.description: Generate OpenAPI 3.0 specs, create Postman collection, write integration guide for frontend team.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration guide reviewed by frontend team

phases.name: Phase 2: Core React Components Integration
phases.description: Integrate the 4 largest React components: TransparencyInsights (956 lines), SwarmDashboard (759 lines), FilterControls (729 lines), AccessibilityEnhancements (686 lines)

tasks.title: Initialize React Project Structure
tasks.description: Set up React 18 + TypeScript project in web-portal/ directory. Configure Material-UI, Zustand, React Query, Socket.IO client, Recharts, Fuse.js, React Window. Copy 9 components from legacy/v1/src/web/frontend/.

tasks.title: Integrate SwarmDashboard Component
tasks.description: Connect SwarmDashboard (759 lines) to backend WebSocket. Display: swarm metrics (8 KPIs), agent status grid, message flow visualization, relaunch history, decision insights preview, test metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent status grid shows live data
All 8 metrics displayed with trend sparklines

tasks.title: Integrate TransparencyInsights Component
tasks.description: Connect TransparencyInsights (956 lines - largest component) to decision tracking API. Implement: Timeline View, Patterns View, Analysis View, Feedback View, Testing View. Support decision filtering (by agent, confidence, tag, date, outcome).

tasks.title: Integrate FilterControls Component
tasks.description: Connect FilterControls (729 lines) with Fuse.js fuzzy search. Support: agent filter, type filter, priority filter, keyword search, date range, metadata toggles.

tasks.title: Integrate AccessibilityEnhancements Component
tasks.description: Implement AccessibilityEnhancements (686 lines) for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Features: keyboard navigation, screen reader support (ARIA labels, live regions), high contrast mode, focus management, skip links, reduced motion support.

tasks.title: Configure Zustand State Management
tasks.description: Set up Zustand store with: connection state, swarmData, messages, agents, interventions, transparencyInsights, filters, UI state. Integrate React Query for API data fetching.

phases.name: Phase 3: Advanced Components & Features
phases.description: Integrate remaining 5 components: MessageViewer (660 lines), MCPIntegrationPanel (618 lines), PerformanceOptimizer (559 lines), AgentStatusPanel (558 lines), InterventionPanel (480 lines)

tasks.title: Integrate MessageViewer Component
tasks.description: Connect MessageViewer (660 lines) with virtual scrolling (react-window). Features: thread-based organization, multi-dimensional filtering, fuzzy search (Fuse.js), real-time streaming, pagination, export (JSON/CSV/Markdown).

tasks.title: Integrate InterventionPanel Component
tasks.description: Connect InterventionPanel (480 lines) to intervention API. Support 9 intervention types: redirect, pause, resume, relaunch, guidance, stop, priority, resource_adjust, swarm_relaunch. Include confirmation dialogs for high-impact operations.

tasks.title: Integrate MCPIntegrationPanel Component
tasks.description: Connect MCPIntegrationPanel (618 lines) for MCP command execution. Features: command selector, parameter forms, execution history.

tasks.title: Integrate AgentStatusPanel Component
tasks.description: Connect AgentStatusPanel (558 lines) as sidebar. Display agent list with status, quick actions, filtering.

tasks.title: Integrate PerformanceOptimizer Component
tasks.description: Connect PerformanceOptimizer (559 lines) HOC for monitoring. Track: render times, memory usage, warnings. Set thresholds: render <16ms, memory alerts.

tasks.title: Implement Error Boundary Hierarchy
tasks.description: Create error boundary hierarchy to catch React errors. Add fallback UI, error logging, optional Sentry integration.

phases.name: Phase 4: Testing, QA & Performance Optimization
phases.description: Comprehensive testing, performance optimization, accessibility audit, and production readiness

tasks.title: Achieve 80% Unit Test Coverage
tasks.description: Write unit tests for all React components, hooks, utilities. Current coverage: ~40%. Target: ≥80%.

tasks.title: Create Integration Tests
tasks.description: Test WebSocket flows, intervention workflows, decision tracking, message streaming, state management integration.

tasks.title: Create E2E Tests with Playwright
tasks.description: Create Playwright tests for complete user workflows: intervention sending, message filtering, decision analysis, agent monitoring.

tasks.title: Conduct Performance Benchmarking
tasks.description: Benchmark: 10,000 message handling, 100 agent monitoring, WebSocket latency, bundle size analysis, memory profiling, render performance.

tasks.title: Full Accessibility Audit
tasks.description: Conduct WCAG 2.1 AA audit using: axe DevTools, manual keyboard testing, screen reader testing (NVDA, JAWS), color contrast verification.

tasks.title: Security Audit & Penetration Testing
tasks.description: Test: input validation, rate limiting, CSRF protection, XSS prevention, WebSocket origin validation, authentication (if applicable).

tasks.title: Optimize Bundle Size
tasks.description: Analyze and optimize bundle: code splitting, tree shaking, lazy loading, compression. Target: <3MB gzipped from current ~5MB.

phases.name: Phase 5: Deployment & Production Readiness
phases.description: Production deployment, monitoring setup, documentation, and knowledge transfer

tasks.title: Create Docker Configuration
tasks.description: Create Dockerfile with multi-stage build: (1) npm ci + build, (2) nginx serve. Include nginx.conf for reverse proxy, health checks, logging.

tasks.title: Configure CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Set up GitHub Actions: (1) on PR: lint, test, build, (2) on merge: build, test, security scan, deploy to staging, (3) manual: deploy to production.
acceptanceCriteria: CI pipeline runs on every PR

tasks.title: Configure Monitoring & Logging
tasks.description: Set up: (1) Application monitoring (performance metrics), (2) Error tracking (Sentry optional), (3) Log aggregation, (4) Alert configuration.

tasks.title: Deploy to Staging Environment
tasks.description: Deploy React portal to staging. Test: WebSocket connectivity, API integration, performance under load, security measures.

tasks.title: Production Deployment
tasks.description: Deploy to production with: (1) Blue-green deployment strategy, (2) Database migrations (if any), (3) Traffic routing, (4) Monitoring validation.

tasks.title: Create User Documentation
tasks.description: Write comprehensive user guide: (1) Portal overview, (2) Feature walkthroughs, (3) Intervention guide, (4) Troubleshooting, (5) FAQ.

tasks.title: Developer Knowledge Transfer
tasks.description: Conduct knowledge transfer sessions: (1) Architecture overview, (2) Codebase walkthrough, (3) Deployment procedures, (4) Maintenance guide, (5) Q&A sessions.

phases.name: Phase 6: Technical Debt Resolution
phases.description: Address technical debt items identified in handoff document

tasks.title: Extract Shared Types to @types Package
tasks.description: Create @types/claude-flow-portal package with: Agent, AgentMessage, DecisionPoint, SwarmMetrics, Intervention, FilterOptions, etc. Share types between frontend and backend.

tasks.title: Consolidate WebSocket Logic into Custom Hook
tasks.description: Create useWebSocket hook with: connection management, auto-reconnection, event subscription, error handling, connection status. Replace all inline WebSocket logic.

tasks.title: Implement Proper Error Boundary Hierarchy
tasks.description: Create error boundary hierarchy: (1) Global ErrorBoundary, (2) Feature-level boundaries, (3) Component-level boundaries. Add fallback UI, error logging, recovery options.

tasks.title: Increase Test Coverage to 90%
tasks.description: Bring test coverage from current 80% to 90%. Focus on: complex business logic, WebSocket interactions, state management, edge cases.

tasks.title: Further Bundle Size Optimization
tasks.description: Reduce bundle from ~3MB to <2MB gzipped. Techniques: dynamic imports for heavy libraries (Chart.js, Fuse.js), remove unused dependencies, optimize Material-UI imports.

phases.name: Phase 7: Enhanced Analytics (Q4 2025)
phases.description: Implement enhanced analytics features: historical performance reports, trend analysis, anomaly detection, custom dashboard builder

tasks.title: Implement Historical Performance Reports
tasks.description: Create report views for 24h, 7d, 30d time ranges. Metrics: agent performance trends, swarm efficiency over time, intervention effectiveness, decision quality evolution.

tasks.title: Implement Trend Analysis & Forecasting
tasks.description: Add trend visualization: linear regression, moving averages, forecasting. Predict: agent load, performance bottlenecks, intervention needs.

tasks.title: Implement Anomaly Detection
tasks.description: Detect anomalies in: agent performance, message patterns, decision confidence, system metrics. Alert on: performance degradation, unusual errors, coordination breakdowns.

tasks.title: Create Custom Dashboard Builder
tasks.description: Allow users to create custom dashboards: drag-and-drop widget placement, metric selection, time range customization, save/load layouts.

successCriteria: Historical reports functional for 3 time ranges

phases.name: Phase 8: Advanced Visualizations (Q1 2026)
phases.description: Implement advanced visualizations: 3D agent network graph, real-time heatmaps, coordination flow diagram, interactive timeline

tasks.title: Implement 3D Agent Network Graph
tasks.description: Create 3D visualization of agent communication using Three.js or D3.js. Show: agent nodes, message flows, coordination patterns, cluster identification.

tasks.title: Create Real-Time Heatmaps
tasks.description: Visualize: agent activity heatmap, message frequency heatmap, performance heatmap, coordination intensity heatmap.

tasks.title: Build Coordination Flow Diagram
tasks.description: Create Sankey diagram showing: message flows between agents, decision dependencies, task handoffs, data flow patterns.

tasks.title: Create Interactive Timeline
tasks.description: Build zoomable timeline showing: events, decisions, interventions, relaunches, test runs. Support: filtering, search, playback, export.

phases.name: Phase 9: AI-Powered Insights (Q2 2026)
phases.description: Implement AI-powered features: predictive intervention suggestions, pattern recognition, automated feedback, performance recommendations

tasks.title: Implement Predictive Intervention Suggestions
tasks.description: Use ML to predict when interventions needed: analyze historical patterns, detect early warning signs, suggest proactive interventions, learn from outcomes.

tasks.title: Implement Pattern Recognition Engine
tasks.description: Automatically detect: recurring decision patterns, coordination patterns, performance patterns, failure patterns. Generate insights and recommendations.

tasks.title: Create Automated Feedback Generation
tasks.description: Generate AI feedback for decisions: analyze outcomes, compare to alternatives, suggest improvements, track feedback effectiveness.

tasks.title: Build Performance Recommendation System
tasks.description: Analyze system performance and recommend: resource adjustments, architecture changes, workflow optimizations, agent reconfigurations.

phases.name: Phase 10: Collaboration Features (Q3 2026)
phases.description: Implement collaboration features: multi-user access, role-based permissions, approval workflows, team notifications

tasks.title: Implement Multi-User Access
tasks.description: Support multiple simultaneous users: authentication, user profiles, concurrent editing, conflict resolution, activity tracking.

tasks.title: Create Role-Based Permission System
tasks.description: Define roles: Admin (full access), Operator (interventions + monitoring), Viewer (read-only), Auditor (read + export). Implement: permission checks, UI adaptation, audit logging.

tasks.title: Implement Intervention Approval Workflows
tasks.description: Add approval process for high-risk interventions: request submission, approval routing, notification, execution after approval, audit trail.

tasks.title: Create Team Notification System
tasks.description: Notify team on: critical events, intervention requests, system alerts, performance issues. Support: email, Slack, Discord, in-app notifications.

risks.title: Large Bundle Size (5MB gzipped)
risks.description: React portal bundle is significantly larger than current vanilla portal (300KB). May impact initial load time.
risks.mitigation: Implement aggressive code splitting, lazy loading, tree shaking. Consider hybrid approach where vanilla portal is default with React as opt-in.

risks.title: Backend API Gaps
risks.description: React portal requires 14 REST endpoints + WebSocket protocol. Current backend may be missing many of these.
risks.mitigation: Complete Phase 1 backend foundation before starting React integration. Create comprehensive API documentation.

risks.title: Maintenance Complexity
risks.description: Adding 6,550 lines of React code + 40+ dependencies significantly increases codebase complexity.
risks.mitigation: Invest in documentation, testing, knowledge transfer. Consider simpler alternatives for specific features.

risks.title: User Disruption During Migration
risks.description: Switching from vanilla to React portal may disrupt users. Learning curve for new UI.
risks.mitigation: Use hybrid approach during transition. Keep vanilla portal available as fallback. Provide comprehensive user documentation and training.

risks.title: WebSocket Scalability
risks.description: Real-time WebSocket connections may not scale beyond 100 concurrent users (currently tested up to 100 agents).
risks.mitigation: Implement connection pooling, load balancing, Redis pub/sub for scaling. Conduct load testing early.

risks.title: Accessibility Regression
risks.description: Complex React components may introduce accessibility issues not present in vanilla portal.
risks.mitigation: Dedicated AccessibilityEnhancements component already exists. Conduct regular accessibility audits. Involve accessibility experts early.
